general_information.Description: 1. Course Objectives: This course provides students with the essential computing foundation for Fintech. The course focuses on developing basic programming skills in Python, SQL to analyze data, manage databases, and perform statistical computing, equipping students with the fundamental tools to solve problems and succeed in the fast-growing FinTech industry. By the end of this course, students will gain the technical proficiency needed to support roles in data-driven financial analysis, algorithmic trading, and financial application development. 2. Course Content: Key topics include: Fundamentals of Programming and Data Analysis in Business; Fundamentals of Python programming; Fundamentals of R programming; Foundation of SQL for data management; Integrating Python and SQL. 3. Activities and Teaching Methodology: Lectures, hands-on coding sessions, and individual and group projects to practice the application of programming techniques using Python, SQL enabling them to apply their skills in practical, job-oriented scenarios.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Describe fundamental programming concepts (variables, data types, control structures) and the role of coding in business analytics.
Collaborate effectively in team-based tasks and communicate coding-based business analysis results in a clear and professional manner.
Perform data import/export operations to load datasets from Excel/CSV files into Python environment.
Apply conditional logic and loops in Python scripts to automate repetitive financial calculation tasks.
Construct SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY clauses to retrieve precise datasets.
Employ Python libraries (NumPy, Pandas) to manipulate tabular data, handling missing values.
Compute key business metrics using SQL aggregation functions (SUM, AVG) and table joins.
Analyze business trends and patterns by interpreting data visualizations generated via Python tools.
Integrate SQL queries within Python scripts to extract and process data, distinguishing their specific roles.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Configure the development environment and run a first Python script to verify readiness for course activities.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2
constructive_questions.Details: Use Python data types and collections (e.g., lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets) to represent simple business entities and records.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3
constructive_questions.Details: Apply if-else statements and loops to solve simple business decision and repetition tasks.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4
constructive_questions.Details: Write reusable Python functions and simple modules to perform basic business or financial calculations.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5
constructive_questions.Details: Use NumPy arrays to perform basic numerical operations and summary statistics on business data.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6
constructive_questions.Details: Import data from CSV or Excel files into Pandas and inspect the structure and quality of the dataset.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7
constructive_questions.Details: Filter, select, and sort data in Pandas to answer basic business questions.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8
constructive_questions.Details: Create new calculated columns and simple KPIs from existing variables in a DataFrame.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9
constructive_questions.Details: Clean a dataset by handling missing values, removing duplicates, and standardizing inconsistent formats.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ10
constructive_questions.Details: Produce summary tables using GroupBy and Pivot-style operations, and combine related datasets using basic merge/join techniques.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ11
constructive_questions.Details: Complete a guided mini workflow from data loading to summary output and reflect on project direction.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12
constructive_questions.Details: Create basic charts to compare categories and show trends in business data using Matplotlib.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ13
constructive_questions.Details: Prepare a simple visual report or dashboard to communicate findings to business stakeholders.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ14
constructive_questions.Details: Retrieve data from a relational database using basic SQL queries with SELECT, FROM, and WHERE.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ15
constructive_questions.Details: Formulate SQL queries with combined conditions and basic JOINs to answer business questions from related tables.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ16
constructive_questions.Details: Compute key business metrics and summary reports using SQL aggregate functions, GROUP BY, and HAVING.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ17
constructive_questions.Details: Build a simple workflow that extracts data with SQL and processes it in Python for further analysis.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ18
constructive_questions.Details: Review and refine an end-to-end business data workflow and justify the chosen steps and tools.

constructive_questions.Name: CQ19
constructive_questions.Details: Present and defend the capstone project by explaining the workflow, code choices, teamwork process, and business insights.
